Downtown CRA - Historic Jackson House Restoration Update - The Community Redevelopment Agency (CRA) in 2022 approved funding of $1M from the Downtown CRA to assist The Jackson House Foundation Board of Directors in the restoration of The Jackson House located at 851 E. Zack St., Tampa, FL 33602. The Foundation’s goal over the next two years is to restore, rebuild, and preserve the historic Jackson House and open a museum to showcase stories of the house, neighborhood, city, African American and other minorities experiences in Tampa through the lens of the Jacksons and their descendants.

Memorandum from Courtney Orr, CRA Development Manager, transmitting a written report for said agenda item. (To be R/F)
agendaItems.background:
On March 12, 2026, The CRA received a Special Projects funding request from the Tampa Arts Alliance for proposed renovations to their new Downtown Arts Center at 201 E. Kennedy Ave., Suite 100, Tampa, FL 33602. The CRA Board motioned (Clendenin-Maniscalco) that the CRA Board move to approve the Downtown Arts Center Funding Request for the total amount of $1,000,000.00. Motion carried unanimously with Miranda and Hurtak being absent.

The Downtown CAC motioned to recommend awarding $700,000 special projects funding reimbursable grant to the Tampa Arts Alliance for the Downtown Arts Center project, allocated as follows: • $300,000 from Downtown Art Projects line item • $400,000 from Neighborhood Infrastructure Capital Improvement Projects line item Based on the CRA Board’s motion, staff requests reallocation of $1 million to fund the Downtown Arts Center's full funding amount requested.

SubjectDowntown CRA - A Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of 
the City of Tampa, Florida, approving Tampa Arts Alliance, Inc.’s Downtown 
Arts Center Renovations Grant Funding and Construction Agreement.
Resolution / 
Ordinance 
Title
File No. CRA26-22716
Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa, 
Florida, approving Tampa Arts Alliance, Inc.’s Downtown Arts Center 
Renovations Grant Funding and Construction Agreement by and between said 
Community Redevelopment Agency (“CRA”) and the Tampa Arts Alliance, Inc. 
(“Awardee”) to renovate and build-out 3,705 square feet, including gallery, 
performance, and community space generally described as the Downtown 
Arts Center at 201 E. Kennedy Ave., Suite 100, Tampa, Fl 33602 (“the Tampa 
Arts Alliance property”) on property located within the boundaries of the 
Downtown Community Redevelopment Area; authorizing execution of the 
Community Redevelopment Grant Funding Agreement by the chair of the 
CRA and attestation by the CRA Secretary; providing an effective date.
Memorandum from Courtney Orr, CRA Development Manager, transmitting a 
written report for said agenda item. (To be R/F)
BACKGROUND:
On March 12, 2026, The CRA received a Special Projects funding request from the Tampa 
Arts Alliance for proposed renovations to their new Downtown Arts Center at 201 E. Kennedy 
Ave., Suite 100, Tampa, FL 33602. The CRA Board motioned (Clendenin-Maniscalco) that 
the CRA Board move to approve the Downtown Arts Center Funding Request for the total 
amount of $1,000,000.00. Motion carried unanimously with Miranda and Hurtak being absent.
The Downtown CAC motioned to recommend awarding $700,000 special projects funding 
reimbursable grant to the Tampa Arts Alliance for the Downtown Arts Center project, 
allocated as follows:
• $300,000 from Downtown Art Projects line item
• $400,000 from Neighborhood Infrastructure Capital Improvement Projects line item
Based on the CRA Board’s motion, staff requests reallocation of $1 million to fund the 
Downtown 
Arts Center's full funding amount requested.
FISCAL IMPACT: Yes

This resolution provides for an agreement in the amount of $1,000,000 with the Tampa Bay 
Art Alliance for the Downtown CRA within the Downtown CRA Fund.
